# Zero UIV Modern Slider

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Modern range slider for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Clean, minimalist aesthetic
- ✅ Smooth hover scaling on the thumb
- ✅ Percentage-style value pill
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Primary Color, Label)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-slider-modern.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-slider-modern 
    label="Saturation" 
    primary-color="#2ed573"
    value="40">
</zero-uiv-slider-modern>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-slider-primary`: Thumb border and accent color
- `--uiv-slider-bg`: Track background color
